title: Account activity reservation membership

effect.user: Keep activity/claim attribution fresh without repeatedly testing unrelated reservation bee IDs.
assertions: Exact activity, generation transfer precedence, ordered first transfer, sorted observed claim IDs.
No durable writes; expiry/release/rollback/reopen remain fresh.

idle.why: No process/provider launch; this workload isolates one synchronous activity calculation.

first-use.why: No process/provider launch; this workload isolates one synchronous activity calculation.

scale.why: Two relevant accounts, one unrelated harness account; 0/12/120/1200 bees and four reservation distributions.

background.why: No process/provider launch; this workload isolates one synchronous activity calculation.

release.why: No process/provider launch; this workload isolates one synchronous activity calculation.

recovery.why: Lifecycle freshness and reopen are separate behavioral controls.

fixture.seed: 32 real SQLite cases: ordinary, transfer, skewed claims and expired/released/unbound history; two repetitions.

recipe.readiness: Seed completed before installing field-read wrappers.
recipe.completion: 32 complete equal expected activity cases and one lifecycle control.
recipe.teardown: Close owned store and remove isolated fixture in finally, including initial open failure.

metrics.scope: beeId field getter reads beyond one per returned reservation during one public nodeActivity report.
metrics.collector: Call-through getter instrumentation on real CoreStore returned rows, installed only during nodeActivity.
metrics.invariant: All 32 cases plus lifecycle control complete, exact activity/durable parity, zero excess reads.
metrics.noise: Deterministic counts; shared-host load does not establish latency.

gaps: Temporary per-call grouping allocation, SQL scans, receipt decoding, CPU and latency remain unmeasured.
readiness: Three alternating pairs retain all six 32-case arms and 96 exact output-hash matches. At 1200 bees with transfers, beeId reads fall from 5043600 to 3600; excess reads from 5040000 to 0. Ordered transfer and fresh expiry/release/rollback/generation/reopen controls pass. Counts only.
